exposure: Prenatal imaging findings suggestive of fetal airway obstruction
outcome: Need for ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedures
cohort: The study included 37 patients with prenatal consultations for potential fetal airway obstruction between 2004 and 2019 at a quaternary pediatric facility.
finding: Midline neck mass location on prenatal imaging was significantly associated with the need for EXIT procedures, while in-utero neck extension, neck vessel compression, micrognathia, and polyhydramnios were better indicators of invasive airway support at birth.
